pages.text: Life is one-handed: its sugars are all right, its amino acids all left. A mirror cell is the reverse, and lives only on mirror food. The growth falls off sharply as the food's purity drops below pure.
$(thing)Set$(): Chirality purity, Feed.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Stray molecules: the purity varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Natural nutrient poisons it.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Pure mirror food is fastest.
